jobs.descriptionText:
Corporate and Institutional Banking
HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.
In This Role, You Will
Impact on the Business/Function
Coordinate the execution of the Outbound strategy, including strategy paper, initiatives formulation, driving actions and track the deliverables.
Drive the in-country execution of the Group's Outbound strategy to drive revenue and achieve the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) targets.
Support customer account strategies and liaise with Regions/Branches assigning prospects and opportunities to HBCN Coverage Bankers / Global Network Banking (GNB) RMs.
Develop metrics and reporting mechanisms that monitor execution of the Outbound strategy.
Interpret and communicate any global GNB and regulatory developments and ensure timely training and familiarization for frontline teams is delivered.
Execute tactical projects to ensure that market firsts are attained for key products and market trends.
Devise strategy to raise Outbound and international awareness/knowledge for front-line colleagues.
Customers / Stakeholders
Build relationships with government officials, trade bodies, commercial chambers and regulators in China. Focus on capturing ODI opportunities.
Participate in meetings with major/high level Outbound clients and prospects, to provide guidance, pitch for new business, resolve any issues, and facilitate smooth operations and services, thus building loyalty and client satisfaction.
Establish the agenda for internal education (e.g. workshops and seminars) and external marketing (client forums and summits).
Deepen customer relationships through championing business co-operation with key stakeholders including Global Business, Global Products and Global Functions, to contribute to Outbound strategy.
Provide 'thought leadership' on Outbound matters to key internal stakeholders and serve as a subject matter expertise on international.
Organize and execute workshops, forums, seminars, roadshows and presentations.
Work with in-country stakeholders where required to remove any blockages for transactions and coordinate escalation to resolve matters in a timely and efficient manner.
Leadership & Teamwork
Work closely with Global Businesses, Global Products and Global Functions to execute a comprehensive strategy for the China Outbound proposition.
Build network with Group offices (including global CIB, GNB and China Desks) to enhance profile and cooperation with China.
Manage China Desk Manager (CDM) proposition/governance and support periodical review on CDM structure to align with China CIB and GNB management. Coordinate feedback to GNB teams on CDM performance and provide support on people management matters.
Operational Effectiveness & Control
Continually assess operational risks associated with the role and inherent in the business, taking account of changing economic or market conditions, legal and regulatory requirements, operating procedures and practices, management restructuring and the impact of new technology.
To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:
Essential
Proven and progressive business development, sales management, and credit experience or equivalent.
Adaptability and mobility. The role may require the jobholder to frequently travel throughout China and work abroad on short term assignments.
Extensive knowledge and proven sales success with the Bank's products and services, or equivalent
Good understanding and knowledge of GNB and experience with working with multinational corporates.
Experience working with senior stakeholders in a global environment.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills including organizational, analytical, negotiation, communication, teamwork and influencing skills.
Ability to set and manage own agenda, while ensuring alignment with stakeholder priorities.
Excellent spoken and written Mandarin and English.
Desired
University graduate degree in business related field, or equivalent experience.
Understanding of local operating markets and their corresponding span(s) of control within assigned region.
Experience of driving strategic change in a matrix environment.
Group Leadership Capabilities - the following capabilities have been identified as essential for this role:
Navigating - Anticipating future needs of stakeholders, reconciling opposing stakeholder needs, ensuring the vision is understood by all stakeholders and translating Group Strategy into immediate business/function.
Aspiring - Knowledge of standards in leading global organizations, driving performance against leading global standards, competing successfully and actively improving capability.
Driving - Enabling others to take the lead, courageously taking on stretching challenges, thriving under pressure, seeking opportunities to transform immediate business/function and set stretching goals.
Mobilizing - Inspiring relevant stakeholders, championing diversity and inclusion within immediate business/function, fully leveraging the matrix, maximizing employee engagement, creating a high-performance culture, optimizing the pace of delivery.
Sustaining - Championing respect and fairness in dealings with others, enhancing the brand of HSBC, and championing HSBC Values and Culture.
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Principal Responsibilities
Design and implement semantic models for key domains, including customer/entity, onboarding journeys, credit exposures, limits, collateral, risk ratings, portfolio hierarchies, and performance measures.
Define and govern KPIs/metrics (e.g., onboarding turnaround time, KYC SLA adherence, application drop-off, approval rate, exposure at default, utilisation, arrears/delinquency, portfolio concentration, risk-adjusted returns), with documentation and lineage.

Optimise semantic performance and cost through appropriate modelling patterns, aggregation strategies, and incremental refresh approaches.
Apply security controls (RBAC/ABAC), row/column-level security and auditing to support controlled access to sensitive onboarding and credit data.
Operate the semantic layer in production: CI/CD, monitoring, incident triage, root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
Partner with Data Engineering, Product Owners, Analysts, Risk and Operations stakeholders to drive adoption and consistent usage.

Establishing “one agreed definition” for critical onboarding, credit and portfolio KPIs used across squads.
Reducing time spent reconciling numbers across reports, dashboards and AI outputs.
Enabling scalable self-serve analytics with clear, discoverable, versioned metric definitions.
Maintaining a stable, performant semantic layer with strong controls and auditability.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Developer to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable backend systems that power Standard Chartered’ s digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platform 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Architecture
Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning
Development & Implementation
Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions
Collaboration & Communication
Work closely with front-end developers, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives
Quality & Compliance
Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required
Skills And Experience
Java (Spring Boot)
Relational DB
MQ
Logging, Monitoring and Alerts
Design Pattern
API
Qualifications
Technical Expertise
3-8 years of experience in backend development with strong Java expertise
Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking capabilities
Experience working in agile development environments
Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
Strong project management and organizational skills
Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex technical concepts
Education & Certifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
Banking or financial services domain knowledge advantageous
Preferred Requirements
Knowledge of performance optimization and system scalability techniques
Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack)

Job Summary
As an AI Ops Engineer, you will play a critical role in the design, development, and deployment of AI platform. Create and maintain documentation for AIOps processes and solutions.
Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent future incidents.

Stay up to date with industry trends, research in artificial intelligence field.
Develop and maintain strong relations ships with internal and external stakeholders.

Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. Job Summary
This role could be based in Singapore or China. When you start the application process you will be presented with a drop-down menu showing all countries, please ensure that you only select a country where the role is based
The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy
Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.
Business
Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.
People and Talent
Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.
Governance
Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.
Regulatory and Business Conduct
Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.
Other Responsibilities
Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
Responsible for building a culture of good conduct
Our Ideal Candidate
10+ years’ experience in software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

负责分支行的业务操作及各项与分支行有关的营运工作，包括柜台交易的办理及系统处理，确保各项分支行工作执行的准确性，合规性和完整性，执行中必须始终遵守并严格按照银行的内外部准则/操作流程/操作手册/标准/集团要求/监管要求/法规等要求，同时始终保持高水准的客户服务质量与体验。

Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

协助分支行实现工作目标
主动倡议或协助银行推进各项成本优化创新方案的实现

Build SCB a great place to work
在日常工作中始终倡导“以客户为中心”的服务理念，给客户提供最优质的服务
在服务中始终秉承“以人为本，以客户为中心”的服务理念，保持并提升内外部客户的服务体验
在分支行日常对外服务中，始终以客户满意为服务宗旨
始终立志于共同将渣打银行构建成一个员工和客户都喜欢的公司

Support Line Manager achieve good MCA rating in branch audit
Escalate for any exception detected or observed in daily work to minimize potential negative impact on the bank

协助主管在银行内部审计中取得良好的MCA (management control approach)成绩

根据银行的内外部要求，确保获得岗位就职需要的各项有效证书

在日常营运工作中，充分理解保护消费者权益的重要性，防止损害消费者的利益
在日常营运工作中，始终遵守与消费者权益保护相关的法规要求，且确保完成相关培训
在日常营运工作中，始终谨记以保护消费者权益为基础执行工作

Job Description
Job Summary
Work in PCVC team to manage the Product control activities for China across Business
Provide strong oversight of the integrity, accuracy and timely reporting of China trading revenues, balance sheet positions and valuation adjustments, ensuring that financial results are appropriately controlled and understood.
Support Team Head to establish and maintain a China-specific Product Control and Valuation Control framework that meets local regulatory requirements while remaining aligned with the bank’s global policies, standards and risk appetite.
Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance and Operations to support sustainable business growth by providing independent challenge, identifying emerging financial and valuation risks, and enabling informed commercial decision-making.
Strengthen the local control environment through effective governance, clear ownership, high-quality management information and the development of capable China-based Product Control and Valuation Control resources.
Manage the Valuation Control deliverables as applicable for China regulatory requirements
Key Responsibilities
Key contributor to China-based Product Control and Valuation Control team, acting as a hands-on subject matter expert. The role combines teamwork and significant individual contribution, particularly in resolving complex control, valuation, accounting and regulatory matters.
Oversee the accuracy, completeness and timeliness of daily and monthly P&L, balance sheet substantiation, valuation adjustments, independent price verification and other core Product Control and Valuation Control activities for the China business.
Support team leader to establish and maintain an effective China-specific control framework that meets local regulatory expectations and is aligned with the bank’s global Product Control and Valuation Control policies, methodologies and governance standards.
Coordinate extensively with global and regional Product Control and Valuation Control teams to obtain technical input, clarify policy requirements, resolve methodology differences and ensure consistent application of global standards within the China business.
Provide independent review and challenge of trading results, valuation methodologies, reserves, model inputs, adjustments and balance sheet positions. Ensure material issues are identified, investigated, escalated and resolved within agreed timelines.
Partner with Front Office, Risk, Finance, Operations, Treasury, Compliance and Technology to support new products, business growth and regulatory initiatives, ensuring that appropriate financial controls and valuation processes are in place before implementation.
Support the China business by providing clear analysis of revenue performance, valuation uncertainty, balance sheet risks, control weaknesses and emerging issues, enabling informed management and commercial decision-making.
Manage regulatory and internal stakeholder requirements, including preparation of management information, responses to regulatory enquiries, audit support, remediation plans and evidence of sustainable control improvements.
Key contributor to achieve improvements in processes, reporting, data quality and automation, reducing manual adjustments and recurring breaks while improving the transparency, efficiency and resilience of the control environment.
Maintain effective governance over material issues, exceptions and control breaches, with clear ownership, action plans, escalation thresholds and reporting to relevant China, regional and global committees.
The role holder is responsible for both the day-to-day effectiveness of the local Product Control and Valuation Control function and the successful coordination of China requirements with the wider global control organisation.
Skills and Experience
Product Control and Valuation Control understanding
Financial Markets and Trading Products
China Regulatory awareness
Control Framework and risk management
Stakeholder Management
Analytical and Communication skills
Valuation knowledge – IPV/FVA/PVA
Motivations
Operating in a complex and evolving China regulatory environment, where local requirements may differ from global standards and require careful interpretation, escalation and practical implementation.
Resolving valuation, P&L and balance sheet issues involving incomplete data, methodology differences, manual processes or unclear ownership across local, regional and global teams.
Building a credible and sustainable local Product Control and Valuation Control framework while working with limited resources, competing priorities and significant dependency on global subject-matter experts.
Managing periods of heightened regulatory, audit or senior-management scrutiny, requiring timely responses, clear evidence of control effectiveness and disciplined delivery of remediation commitments.
Challenging senior business and functional stakeholders on valuation assumptions, manual adjustments, control weaknesses and financial risks, while maintaining constructive relationships and supporting business objectives.
Driving long-term process and control improvements where solutions require coordination across multiple teams, changes to systems or data, and sustained follow-through rather than short-term fixes.
Qualifications
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across different regulatory, cultural and organisational environments, adapting o global frameworks and local requirements while preserving appropriate governance, control and consistency
Proven Experience dealing complex issues through ambiguity, bringing together multiple stakeholders, forming a clear view from incomplete conflicting information and driving decisions and remediation through to sustainable closure
CICPA & CFA is preferred
Languages: Chinese and English
